intro: Soft, serene, and effortlessly charming, this white and blue cotton throw adds a touch of warmth and style to any space. Thoughtfully designed, it blends comfort and elegance for everyday coziness.

features.title: Threads of love, stitched in cotton
features.text: Made from high-quality cotton, this throw offers a soft, breathable, and durable fabric perfect for all-season use.

features.title: Pairs with everything
features.text: The harmonious interplay of white and blue hues lends this throw a clean and contemporary vibe. It seamlessly complements a wide variety of interior styles.

features.title: Feels like a hug, wears like a dream
features.text: This throw doubles as a snug companion for chilly nights and a protective layer for your furniture, shielding against wear and tear while adding a touch of elegance.

care: Dry clean recommended or Gentle Hand wash with mild detergent and cold water.
name: 50x70 Cotton Throw
